description: Checks whether a passage appears in a regulator's source document; accepts text from any source. Inputs: `text` (up to 5,000 words); optional `register_id` (without it, up to 3 candidate documents are located by search). `outcome` is one of: exact (contiguous in the source, quote marks and dashes as the source writes them; a line break counts as a space); normalized (matches after folding quote and dash typography, `typography_folded`; ignoring page footers or running heads, `furniture_ignored`; spacing where the stored source splits or joins words, `spacing_ignored`; or added list markers, `list_markers_ignored`); composed (every word is in the source, in source order, but from non-contiguous pieces, as with an overview or an ellipsis; `omissions` lists the short source phrases skipped between pieces); not_found (no source support; `unsupported` lists the unsupported spans, and on a near miss `differences` gives the closest source text, the source words the text lacks and the words it adds); not_checked (over 5,000 words). `coverage` is the share of words found. `checked_against` names the documents checked (document, edition, retrieval date; ids in `checked_snapshot_ids`); `matched_against` names the one matched, `matched_register_id` / `matched_obligation_id` the stored text containing the passage. `matched_version` is current; superseded (the text is a prior version of the rule; `superseded_by` is the current register); or update-18-optional (HUD's Update 18 revision of an FHA 4000.1 section, optional until `mandatory_date`; `in_force_obligation_id` is the text in force by default). `obligation_currency` lists currency signals on the obligation holding the text (e.g. superseded-in-part). `rescinded: true` (with `rescinded_by`) means the passage is text a later issuance removed or replaced.
name: verify_quote

also_in_obligation_id.description: On a match in an amending issuance: the amended obligation that also carries the text.

checked_against.description: Source documents checked (document, edition, retrieval date).

coverage.description: Share of the text's words found in the source (0 to 1).

differences.description: On a near miss: {closest_source, missing_from_quote, extra_in_quote}.

error.description: Present only on an error or refusal: not_found, ambiguous, unparsed, empty_terms, unknown_playbook, unknown_reference, offset_out_of_range, daily_capacity_reached.

fallback.description: On daily_capacity_reached: where the full corpus can be downloaded.

furniture_ignored.description: A page footer or running head was ignored.

guidance.description: On a refusal or empty search: the server's explanation.

hint.description: On an error: the server's explanation.

mandatory_date.description: On an Update 18 revision: when it becomes mandatory.

matched_against.description: The checked document the text matched.

matched_obligation_id.description: The obligation whose stored text contains the passage.

matched_register_id.description: The register whose stored text contains the passage.

matched_version.description: current, superseded (a prior version) or update-18-optional.

notice.description: Terms notice: research use only, not legal advice.

omissions.description: On composed: short source phrases skipped between pieces.

outcome.description: exact: contiguous in the source; normalized: matches after typography, spacing, footer or list-marker folding; composed: all words in source order, non-contiguous; not_found: no source support; not_checked: over 5,000 words.

resets.description: On daily_capacity_reached: when capacity resets (00:00 UTC).

segments.description: On composed: source pieces the text is assembled from.

superseded_register_id.description: On superseded: the register holding the prior text.

typography_folded.description: Matched after folding quotes and dashes.

unsupported.description: On not_found: spans with no source support.

title: Verify quote
